report_text: Worker performed maintenance without isolating electrical energy.
Worker entered a vessel without proper gas testing.
Welding was performed without a proper hot work permit.
Worker was standing below a suspended load.
Worker slipped while walking in the office but was not seriously injured.
Employee worked on scaffold without guardrails at height.
Technician bypassed lockout tagout procedure during panel repair.
Crew member entered silo without confined space entry permit.
Cutting operation performed without fire watch or hot work permit.
Employee walked under a raised forklift load.
Rigger used unrated chain for a critical lift.
Worker climbed ladder above six feet without fall arrest system.
Employee tripped over a cable in the corridor.
Fitter opened flange on live line without isolation and drained system.
Minor paper cut while handling documents at the desk.
